slides.text: Workshop template The opening Episode of a workshop: copy it once per Event for the agenda, the scope and the organisers. Webinar · replace with the date Engine Generative AI The tool you use 1 First step prompt built in You 2 Second step prompt built in You 3 Third step prompt built in Agentic: the way of working

Hook Replace with a hook or a grounding. A hook opens with one question or claim; a grounding sets the picture the evening builds on. A copy that grounds renames this slug to grounding. Replace with the one question or claim that opens the session.

Agenda Replace with the plan of the session: each block with its time slot. 1 00:00 Welcome Start 2 00:00 The first Episode Episode 1 Theory 3 00:00 The second Episode Episode 2 Theory 4 00:00 The third Episode Episode 3 Theory 5 00:00 Live demo Demo 6 00:00 Hands-on and questions Practice

Where do you stand? What you say about the poll Phones out: scan the code, four questions, half a minute, one answer each. The questions are poll v1 and stay the same so answers compare across Events (AIE-0016); change them only with a new version in the question register. The results load only on click, so nothing goes to directpoll before.

About me Bio facts are placeholders The role and the three facts are placeholders: replace them with what you want this audience to know about you, in both languages. Keep it to what you can say in one breath.

Organisation What to say about the organisation Replace with what you say while this Slide is up. Pause first Pause the recording before you take a question, so no participant's voice lands in the published recording. Replace or drop this note if the session is not recorded.
